# Roster (v20.2.0) — roles, agent types, lanes

<!-- Generated by tools/build_adapters.py from registry/ — do not edit; change the manifest and re-run. -->

Lanes: `tensura/…` globs are workspace-relative, all others project-relative, `!` excludes. Every role may also write `tensura/reports/<TASK>/**`, `tensura/tasks/<TASK>/**`, `tensura/backups/<TASK>/**`. Cecilia narrows lanes per project in `.cecilia/config.json` → `lanes`. Review guides are paths inside the cecilia-review skill.

## Agent types (permissions)

| Agent type | Writes | May dispatch | Main thread | Claude Code tools | Antigravity tools | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| orchestrator | tensura-only | yes | yes | Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash, AskUserQuestion, WebSearch, WebFetch | view_file, list_dir, find_by_name, grep_search, write_to_file, replace_file_content, multi_replace_file_content, run_command, search_web, read_url_content, invoke_subagent, manage_subagents, send_message, ask_question, manage_task | Cecilia's main thread. Proposes workflow options, dispatches roles, reads their reports, relays questions and action quotes. Writes only under the workspace tensura/; never does specialist work. |
| reviewer | none | no | no | Read, Grep, Glob, WebSearch, WebFetch · deny Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit, Bash, Agent, mcp__* | view_file, list_dir, find_by_name, grep_search, search_web, read_url_content | Independent judgement, one lens per instance. Read-only by construction: no edit, shell, MCP or delegation tools; returns its report as text. |
| tester | lane | no | no | inherit (session tools) · deny Agent | view_file, list_dir, find_by_name, grep_search, write_to_file, replace_file_content, multi_replace_file_content, run_command, search_web, read_url_content | Writes and runs tests inside its lane, one lens per instance; several instances may run in parallel. Cannot dispatch other agents. |
| writer | lane | no | no | inherit (session tools) · deny Agent | view_file, list_dir, find_by_name, grep_search, write_to_file, replace_file_content, multi_replace_file_content, run_command, search_web, read_url_content | Builds inside its lane (code, docs, designs, migrations, pipelines). Inherits the session's tools, MCP included, so the guard judges each call; cannot dispatch other agents. |
